metadata.Name: Polyglot-NER
metadata.Description: A massive multilingual named entity recognition (NER) resource that covers 40 languages. The annotations were bootstrapped using Freebase-Wikipedia mapping and projected from English to other languages using inter-language links.
metadata.Paper Title: Polyglot-NER: Massive Multilingual Named Entity Recognition
metadata.Venue Title: Proceedings of the 2015 SIAM International Conference on Data Mining
metadata.Venue Name: SIAM International Conference on Data Mining
metadata.Abstract: We present a massively multilingual named entity recognition (NER) resource that covers 40 languages. We use the freebase-wikipedia entity mapping to bootstrap our annotation process. We use the inter-language links in Wikipedia to project the annotations from English to other languages. We show that our resource has a reasonable quality, and that it can be used to train a state-of-the-art NER system. We demonstrate the utility of our resource by training a state-of-the-art NER system and showing that it performs competitively to other systems that were trained on smaller, but higher-quality, manually-annotated datasets. We release our resource to the public to encourage more research in massively multilingual NLP.
